acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Isometric Minimal style When layout Then 2.5D blocks, isometric grid, layered depth
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: isometric diamond clip-path elements, layered box-shadows creating 3D depth, isometric grid background pattern, colored blocks
